title: introduce-prefill-economizer-slice-and-tiered-quant-ladder
author: Anika Bose
commits: c4f9b3d - implement slice allocator core loop and slot scoring
b2d7a11 - add quant ladder selection and fallback hooks
f1a4e89 - telemetry and metrics for econ.prefill and quant.ladder
9c3e2f0 - console defaults and presets for tenant rollout
a7d8b66 - integration tests and synthetic workload harness
description: Motivation: Many tenants exhibit mixed small/large request shapes and we observed suboptimal per-token unit economics when using a single prefill strategy plus a static quant profile. This PR introduces two coordinated improvements to reduce unit cost while preserving SLOs: 1) a slice-based prefill economizer that dynamically chooses prefill slice sizes per-tenant and per-model shape; 2) a tiered quantization 'ladder' that picks quant profiles (fp16 -> int8 -> int4) with quality gates and rollback hooks. High level approach: runtime/prefill implements a lightweight scoring function using recent sequence-length histogram and cold/hot KV-hit indicators to select slice templates; runtime/quant exposes the ladder manager which evaluates latency/cost delta and triggers a conservative quant step only when eval signals are within configured quality thresholds. Safety & rollouts: default rollout is canaryed at 5% tenants for 48h with automatic rollback if 95th-latency increases by >10% or embedding drift (cosine) exceeds 0.02. There is also a forced-safe-fallback to model-variant or previous quant profile on decode quality regressions. Telemetry & observability: adds econ.prefill.slice_choice, econ.prefill.slice_hit_rate, quant.ladder.chosen_profile, quant.ladder.fallbacks, econ.unit_cost_estimate and a prefill-telemetry dashboard. Performance: synthetic benchmark on mixed chat+completion workload shows median unit-cost reduction of 12% and average token cost down 9% with median latency change +3ms and 95th latency within SLO for all tracked tenants. Tests: unit tests for allocator scoring, quant ladder selection logic, integration e2e against benchmark-lab synthetic traces, and smoke tests for console defaults. Migration/ops: console defaults include conservative presets; dedicated and private installers respect tenant opt-out. Release notes: included. Related: ENG-2345 (prefill autosizing), ENG-2410 (quant ladder design). Merge notes: squash-merged after CI green and two approvals. Checklist: [x] design doc linked; [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests; [x] perf numbers; [x] observability; [x] canary plan.

Anika Bose: Added cold_kv unit test and max_tokens guard in the allocator loop (see commit c4f9b3d). Also added an e2e that simulates bursty cold traffic.

Elena García: Telemetry names look good but please include lifecycle tags (tenant_id, model_version, rollout_bucket) on econ.unit_cost_estimate so dashboards can be grouped; minor: prefer quant.ladder.selected -> quant.ladder.chosen_profile for consistency.
Anika Bose: Renamed metric to quant.ladder.chosen_profile and added lifecycle tags in f1a4e89. Also documented grouping in docs/observability/prefill_metrics.md.
Derrick Owens: Integration test flaky once; CI showed a transient failure in benchmark-lab harness; suggest retry and add a 200ms jitter to synthetic generator to reduce deterministic collision.

release_notes: Introduces slice-based prefill economizer and a tiered quantization ladder that reduce unit costs with conservative safety gates. Includes defaults, observability, and canary rollout plan; operators can opt out per-tenant.
